title: microwave pasta cooker
text: microwave pasta cooker. This works well for single serving of pasta.  I think it's easier clean up too.  The one thing I don't like is the plastic bottom.  Once you heat it, it will off gas.  The top/strainer is silicone.  We don't use it that often.  I wish the bottom was glass.  It would be 10 stars then. product_metadata.title: Lekue Quick Microwave Pasta Cooker, one size, Terracotta
features: Cook complete pasta recipes in the microwave and now includes a spaghetti portion guide in base.

Pasta cooker scientifically design to cook a variety of pastas within minutes in the microwave. Save time with no need to boil water first; specifically designed so water doesn't overflow in the microwave while cooking
Specifically designed to wash, cook and drain your pasta in the same vessel; the lid becomes a colander
Use for a wide variety of pastas including spaghetti, short pasta, fresh pasta, noodles etc.
Dishwasher safe: made in plastic and 100% platinum silicone
